metadata.case_name: ATTORNEY GENERAL v. CHUN YAT NAM

plaintiff.occupation_before: Police constable attached to the Special Duties Unit of the RHKPF

injuries.description: There is no dispute that as a result of his injury the plaintiff suffered anoxic brain damage.
source: There is no dispute that as a result of his injury the plaintiff suffered anoxic brain damage.

injuries.description: his eye sight had a very substantially reduced visual arc. It was only 15 to 20 degrees in both eyes. He concluded then that the overall impairment to the visual system was 67%.
source: his eye sight had a very substantially reduced visual arc. It was only 15 to 20 degrees in both eyes. He concluded then that the overall impairment to the visual system was 67%.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of eye or orbit, unspecified

injuries.description: The plastic bullet had lodged in his left pulmonary artery and had to be surgically removed.
source: The plastic bullet had lodged in his left pulmonary artery and had to be surgically removed.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of pulmonary blood vessels

injuries.description: cardiac damage with limited exercise tolerance (cardiac status described as 'stable' but exercise tolerance limited).
source: In August 1990, it was found that his cardiac status was "stable". However an exercise stress test had to be halted because of the plaintiff's difficulty in breathing and it was the view of the examining doctor that his "exercise tolerance is limited".
loss of a substantial part of his sight together with the cardiac damage is indeed a very grave blow.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of heart, unspecified without open wound into thoracic cavity

injuries.description: There had been one episode of epilepsy while the plaintiff was in hospital.
source: there had been one episode of epilepsy while the plaintiff was in hospital

manifestations.description: mild weakness and ataxia (lack of co-ordination) of the upper limbs
very substantially reduced visual arc / bilateral contraction of visual field to central 10-20 degrees
reduced visual acuity (visual acuity had dropped)
memory impairment (memory range on the lower borderline of normal; memory considerably worse)
personality change (described as forgetful and irritable; marriage impaired)
one episode of epilepsy while in hospital
limited exercise tolerance / difficulty in breathing on exertion
reduced fine coordination and diminished hand-grip (about half the power of a normal person)
effectively unemployable / loss of earning capacity as a police officer

losses.description: Severe permanent reduction of visual field (bilateral contraction to central 10-20 degrees) and disqualification from driving
Personality change: forgetful, irritable, increased neuroticism, anxiety, tension and depression; marriage impaired

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Can no longer take part in football, basketball, golf and other strenuous physical activities he previously enjoyed
Robbed of his career as a police officer; effectively unemployable in meaningful police work
Marriage impaired and reduced quality of family life
